title: Live at the North Sea Jazz Festival, The Hague
studio_context: Filmed for Dutch television (World of Jazz), 14 July 1978: Channel One Suite, Birdland, Grand Concourse, Big Swing Face, Ya Gotta Try.

drum_performances.name: Buddy Rich
drum_performances.why_it_matters: A whole concert in colour at his peak; two of Drumeo's five Buddy licks come from it.

notable_moments.description: A 'one-handed roll': three left-hand strokes and the bass drum or floor tom, repeated (Drumeo).
A ride-cymbal lick in single strokes, the bass drum landing with the cymbal at its end (Drumeo).
